records.name: Undergraduate Assembly (UA)
records.summary: Penn's elected student government. It decides how student groups get funded, pushes for changes that help students, and runs services for undergraduates.
records.what_you_do: Attend the open General Body Meetings, which the public may also attend. Students can also apply to be an associate member when the fall application opens, run for an elected seat, or fill out the interest form for updates.

schedule.text: General Body Meetings on Sunday evenings in JMHH room 370, listed weekly from August 30 through November 29, 2026

locations.label: Huntsman Hall (JMHH), room 370, for General Body Meetings
UA address as published on its website

first_step.how: Come to an open General Body Meeting, or fill out the UA interest form to get updates on elections and member applications.
first_step.basis: Meetings are open to the public and the group gives a clear way to get updates.

records.notes: The 2026 meeting dates come from the directory's event list. The club's own site shows no dated items. The directory status reads UNDER REVIEW. No exact tag exists for student government, so civic_association is the closest fit.

records.name: Undergraduate Chemistry Society at Penn
records.summary: Penn's student chapter of the American Chemical Society. It runs chemistry talks and career events, social nights, and outreach visits with Philadelphia-area high schools.
records.what_you_do: Join chemistry talks, professional events, and social nights, or help with outreach to area high schools. Membership is by application.

first_step.how: Fill out the society's application form, which is linked from its Penn Clubs entry. The directory shows a deadline of 9/14 with no year.
first_step.basis: An application is required before you join.

records.notes: The society's own page returned HTTP 403, so no events could be read there. The directory events list is empty and the deadline has no year. Status is probably active only because the directory lists the club as active.

records.name: Undergraduate Economics Society (UES)
records.summary: Penn's large student economics society. It runs speaker series, coffee chats with professors, and academic talks, and its Almanac committee produces a magazine two times a year.
records.what_you_do: Join the listserv to become a general member and hear about events. Students can also apply for a committee (Academic, Events and Professional Development, Finance and Outreach, Marketing, or Almanac) when applications open each semester.

first_step.how: Join the UES listserv from the club's website to become a general member. Committee applications go out on the listserv at the start of each semester.
first_step.basis: The site says new members are always welcome and all majors are welcome; committee seats need an application.

records.notes: Status left unknown. The club's site is live but shows no dated items, and the only dated items in the directory are Spring 2021 and Fall 2021 SAC Fair badges. The directory status reads UNDER REVIEW.

records.name: Undergraduate Geography Club
records.summary: A GeoGuessr and geography club for Penn undergraduates. Members learn to identify places from visual clues, play ranked games, and compete against other universities in a collegiate league.
records.what_you_do: Come to weekly meetings and casual GeoGuessr sessions, or try out for the competitive team, which practices and joins the Collegiate GeoGuessr League. Competing is optional.

schedule.text: General body meetings weekly on Mondays at 7 pm, starting September 14, in Huntsman Hall room 365 (listed under Fall 2026)

first_step.how: Sign up with the club's listserv form or email the club, then come to a meeting or casual session. No experience is needed.
first_step.basis: The club runs an orientation session for new students and says casual sessions are open to everyone.

records.notes: The event lines on the club's page carry no year. The 2026 comes from the 'Fall 2026' heading over the weekly meeting schedule, so the last sign of life rests on that heading. The directory status reads PRELIMINARY. Whether non-Penn people may attend is not stated.

records.name: Undergraduate Moot Court at Penn
records.summary: Penn students who write appellate briefs from real cases and argue them at regional moot court competitions. Members practice writing, reasoning, and quick thinking.
records.what_you_do: Write briefs of 19 to 30 pages and argue them before attorneys and judges at American Moot Court Association regional competitions.

first_step.how: No joining steps are published. The directory says the club is not accepting members right now.
first_step.basis: The directory says the club is not accepting members and gives no way in.

records.notes: The directory lists the club as active with no dated items, no website, and an unexplained application flag (value 5). Probably active is based only on that listing.

records.name: Underrepresented Student Advisory Board in Engineering (USABE)
records.summary: Penn Engineering students who speak up for underrepresented students. They run surveys and town halls, offer academic and career programs, and pass student feedback to the engineering dean and the diversity office.
records.what_you_do: Share your experience at a survey or town hall, join the programs, or apply for the first-year ambassador or liaison role. Any student may join.

first_step.how: Join the mailing list from the group's site to get updates, or apply for the first-year ambassador or liaison role.
first_step.basis: Any student is welcome to join, though some roles need an application.

records.notes: The club's site says 'Updated August 2025', which is its only dated item. The directory lists two application links, one that refers to a Fall 2024 form and one that refers to a Fall 2026 form. Check which is current before sending anyone to it. The closest tag for underrepresented engineering students is racial_equity, though the group's work covers more than race.

records.name: UnEarthed Penn
records.summary: A student-run magazine at Penn that makes free issues for young readers. Writers, designers, and editors work together on each one.
records.what_you_do: Write articles, edit them for younger readers, or design the pages. Each role has its own application form on the recruitment page.

first_step.how: Apply for a writing, associate editor, or design role through the application form on the recruitment page.
first_step.basis: Every role needs an application before you join.

records.notes: The recruitment page has no dates. The directory's 'Sept 6' deadline has no year, so it is not used for status. The directory says the club is not accepting members, which conflicts with the open applications on its recruitment page. The directory and the site disagree on the reader age range, so the summary avoids naming an age. The directory's email is a Gmail address, while the site's mailto link points to a placeholder.

records.name: UNICEF at Penn
records.summary: A Penn student group that works for children's rights here and abroad. Members raise money, speak up on issues like health and fairness, and volunteer.
records.what_you_do: Fill out the interest form to join the email list, or apply for a committee or leadership role. The Fall 2026 committee and leadership applications were due September 4, 2026.

first_step.how: Fill out the interest form to join the email list. Committee and leadership seats need an application.
first_step.basis: Anyone can join the email list, though committee and leadership seats need an application.

records.notes: The only dated item is the September 4, 2026 application deadline. The directory events list is empty, and the club has no website of its own. Whether non-Penn people may attend is not stated.

records.name: University Honor Council (UHC)
records.summary: A Penn student group that promotes academic integrity. Members serve on student conduct hearings, run awareness campaigns about honest work, and speak up on campus policy.
records.what_you_do: Serve on student conduct hearings, help with campaigns about academic honesty, and advocate across campus. Follow the group on Instagram for recruitment dates.

first_step.how: Fill out the club's interest form, or follow its Instagram for recruitment information.
first_step.basis: Recruitment timing is only posted on Instagram, and the directory does not say whether an application is needed.

records.notes: The directory lists the club as active with no dated items and no website. The application flag (value 4) is unexplained. The interest form's link was not captured. No exact tag exists for academic integrity, so board_service is the closest fit for hearing service.

records.name: UPGRADE
records.summary: Penn's game development club. Members make a club game each semester, host game jams and workshops, and bring in speakers from the games industry.
records.what_you_do: Join the Discord, come to Saturday meetings, and drop in on office hours or work sessions. You do not need experience or an application to start.

schedule.text: Saturday meetings from 2 to 5 pm in Towne 217, and office hours on Wednesdays at 8 pm in Levine 057

first_step.how: Join the Discord, then come to a Saturday meeting or office hours. Students meet in person, and new members join at the start of each semester.
first_step.basis: The club's site says no experience and no applications are needed, and the Discord is open at any time.

records.notes: The newest dated item on the club's site is a February 22, 2025 game night. The directory's application flag says 1, but both the directory description and the club's site say no applications are needed, so the record follows them. The directory's location text reads 'JMHH, usually room 355', while its meeting text gives Towne 217.

records.name: Upstage A Cappella
records.summary: Penn's musical a cappella group. Members sing pop songs from musicals, movies, and TV, and volunteer at hospitals and schools.
records.what_you_do: Audition at the start of each semester alongside the other Penn a cappella groups. Once in, members sing, perform, and do community service.

first_step.how: Go to the start-of-semester audition, held with the other a cappella groups. Updates are posted on Instagram.
first_step.basis: An audition is required before you join.

records.notes: The directory lists the club as active with no dated items and no website. The application flag (value 3) is unexplained. Whether non-Penn people may audition or attend is not stated.

records.name: Veritas Forum at Penn
records.summary: A student-run group that plans campus forums on life's biggest questions. Experts from different fields discuss them on stage, and the audience asks questions.
records.what_you_do: Help the student planning team put on a forum, register to attend one through the website, or sign up for the newsletter.

schedule.text: Forums about once or twice a year. The most recent listed was April 6, 2026, at 7 pm ET.

first_step.how: Register for a forum through the website's form, or use the Connect section to ask about joining the planning team.
first_step.basis: The way in is unclear: the site does not say who may register or how to join the planning team.

records.notes: The campus page lists Penn forums dated November 18, 2024, November 10, 2025, and April 6, 2026. The April 6 forum is the newest. The directory's contact is an individual's Penn email, which is left out. The directory status reads UNDER REVIEW.

records.name: Vietnamese Students' Association (VSA)
records.summary: A Penn student group that shares Vietnamese and Vietnamese-American culture through volunteer work, cultural performances, and social nights. It also runs a mentorship program.
records.what_you_do: Anyone can join, whether or not they already know Vietnamese culture. Members help with the annual Spring Culture Show, service projects, and social events, and can take part in the mentorship program.

first_step.how: Sign up through the group's form, linked from its Linktree and Instagram, then come to events. Anyone can join.
first_step.basis: The group says anyone can join and that its events are open to everyone, and it lists a sign-up form.

records.notes: The newest item on the club's Linktree is a 'Culture Show 2027' listing with a tentative late March or early April date. No dated item shows past activity in the last year. The directory status reads UNDER REVIEW, and its application flag (value 1) conflicts with the description, which says no application is required. Non-Penn attendance is not stated, so the audience is set to students.

notes: Penn Clubs batch of 20 entries. Each was read through the public directory endpoint, plus one club website where the entry linked one (34 fetches, 0 searches, budget was 0). Held back with no summary under the inactive rule: umoja, united-minorities-council-umc, volunteer-income-tax-assistance (VITA), wastewise-at-penn, we-can-swim. Hidden: upstream (no public way in). Five entries carry an INACTIVE status flag that conflicts with their active flag, and that conflict drives most holds. Undated directory items and the 2021 SAC Fair badges were not used as dated evidence. One directory contact was an individual's Penn email and was left out. The main question for review: VITA shows a Fall 2026 application in an entry flagged INACTIVE, so it was held rather than published. Leads only: none found; the entries named no partner groups.
